server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

layers.name: server
layers.note: The database outcome is pg_xact_status() and marker visibility on a second connection.

layers.name: protocol
layers.note: This run does not capture packets. A command tag inferred from node-postgres is that driver parsing CommandComplete.

layers.name: driver
layers.note: Driver observations are fields on the pg query result, or Client.getTransactionStatus().

layers.name: pool
layers.note: A pool is in the process. This scenario does not record a reset statement. The command tag is read from the client result inside the transaction call, before the connection is released.

layers.name: transaction_manager
layers.note: PostgresQueryRunner.commitTransaction is TypeORM's transaction operation. It stays in the framework layer so the record does not invent a second boundary inside one library.

layers.name: framework
layers.note: The application-facing call is the framework transaction API.

layers.name: application
layers.note: The application is the subject code in this experiment.

server_command_tag.basis: Inferred from Result.command on the pg result the framework received. No packet was captured.

capability_notes.command_tag: The wrapper saw Result.command ROLLBACK for COMMIT.

command_tag.basis: Diagnostic wrapper on the pg.Client.prototype.query this framework resolves.

row_count.basis: Row count was not the measurement.

sqlstate.basis: SQLSTATE from the caught duplicate insert.

intermediate_layers.note: The framework uses a pg pool of one connection. Reset statements were not recorded. The command tag is read from Client.query before release.

application_observation.basis: prisma.$transaction(callback) resolved. Statements: BEGIN [resolved BEGIN]; COMMIT [resolved ROLLBACK]. @prisma/adapter-pg 7.10.1 executes COMMIT. PgQueryable.executeRaw returns rowCount.

interpretation.note: @prisma/client 7.10.1 calls prisma.$transaction(callback). The pg result of COMMIT is recorded by the wrapper, not by the framework return value. @prisma/adapter-pg 7.10.1 executes COMMIT. PgQueryable.executeRaw returns rowCount. Defect claim: not made.

boundary_basis: The independent check found a rollback. The driver exposed command tag ROLLBACK on the query result. The framework reported success, and the application received that success.

evidence.statement: pg_xact_status() aborted, marker visible false, session idle. BEGIN [resolved BEGIN]; COMMIT [resolved ROLLBACK]

limits: Drizzle 1.0.0-rc.4 was not repeated. The suite already recorded the same TX-01A shape for 0.45.4 and the release candidate.
Lucid and MikroORM are not separate rows. Knex and Kysely are the libraries those adapters place on pg.
No packet capture. The server command tag is inferred from Result.command.
psycopg, asyncpg, pgjdbc, and Npgsql were not run.
